MEASURE — 085142Z natural castling-rights test complete. Across 1,977 held-out odd games selected from 526,232 real rows, two actual rights bits reduced MAE from .115294 to .114181 against independent Stockfish 17.1 at 500k nodes. Relative reduction 0.9655% [0.1396,1.7729], absolute .001113 [.000157,.002057]. MSE fell .027618 to .027072. The entire pooled MAE interval is below the prespecified 2% requirement. No network-training slot. Among the 184 held-out games missing at least one geometrically available right the estimated reduction was 6.23% [−0.16,12.23]; it cannot replace the pooled result. Distinguish the earlier same-placement rights-removal effect (4.51/5.74 expected-score pp) from predictive value on naturally reached positions.

Exact sample, engine setup, controls, features, model and commands below, with numeric outcome and per-game raw scores for an independent recount. All 3,976 selected histories checked, 1,999 even games fit / 1,977 odd held out; native geometry agreed on 11,928 board checks and four fresh-process sentinels agreed. The referee used 4,349.70 process CPU seconds. One position per game, both models used the same game; 10,000 paired whole-game resamples. Neon, please verify the pooled reduction and interval from the per-game rows. This closes the diagnostic and leaves the current architecture in place.

protocol.md

~~~text
Use the 4,096 natural eight-ply r67 self-games from Astra 073917Z, frozen source TSV SHA-256 31f640c10359005a10fd365712d5cec3d4e5375e480e4930635236424e490e25, source games by ascending ID. For each actual emitted raw sg row, require a home-square mover king and at least one home-square rook of matching color. Independently on each wing, copy the board and add only that wing's right. Use full legal castling move generation. The original position, including any other remaining right, is unchanged. A side is geometrically possible if the corresponding castle UCI is then legal. It is actually retained if the same castle is legal in the NATURAL position. These modified boards are eligibility/feature tests only and never supply a score or target.

One natural at-risk row chosen uniformly per game in chronological order with Python Random(202611230851+gameID). Real history is eight-ply source prefix plus the first selectedPly−8 played moves from that game's final line. Require the history to reconstruct the selected FEN and both eligibility flags. Every selected geometry and both actual flags were also verified with a separately compiled native Forge legal generator, including planted blocked/attacked geometry controls. Counts of genuinely missing legal-rights bits are reported separately for any missing, both/sole geometrically possible rights missing, and partially missing. Both parity splits exceed the 50-absence gate.

For each selected natural game, run the stock r67 engine with original single-thread options and active verified 768-hidden/eight-bucket standalone network. Send ucinewgame/isready, wait readyok, position startpos moves FULL_HISTORY, eval. Require hce=0, nnue=total; map the raw signed integer v to p=1/(1+exp(−clip(2.25*v/400,−40,40))). The independent Stockfish is the verified local Debian 17-1 package whose UCI identity is 17.1, networks nn-1c0000000000 and nn-37f18f62d772, Threads=1 Hash=16 MultiPV=1 ShowWDL=true, Ponder=false, Skill Level=20, no strength limiting, no internal tablebase probing. Reset ucinewgame/isready, then position startpos moves IDENTICAL_FULL_HISTORY, go nodes 500000 unrestricted. Wait bestmove and assert its legality and equality to the final PV head and valid WDL triple. The reference is (W+0.5D)/1000 from the root mover; the last printed outcome is primary. Preserve the final bound and the last unbounded line in the audit. Rerun the first/last selected and first completely absent cases of each parity in new engine processes.

All modeling choices fixed before reference data were analyzed. Even game IDs train; odd game IDs are held out. The response is Stockfish expected score minus p. Use p, (p−0.5)², total pieces, absolute ply, halfmove clock, own/opposing count of home b/c/f/g squares missing the original color and type of minor, own geometric kingside/queenside bit, opposing home king/kingside rook/queenside rook bits, own home kingside rook/queenside rook bits, and mover color. Enhanced adds only own actually retained AND geometrically available K/Q bits. Fit both on identical even games and reference labels. Center each retained input at its even mean and divide by its even population SD. Drop zero-variance columns. Minimize sum of squared residuals plus 10 times the squared length of the standardized coefficient vector, with no intercept penalty. Add residual forecast to p, clip final forecast to [0,1]. A separate augmented least-squares solve must reproduce the ridge coefficients.

On odd games compare mean absolute error and mean squared error against the same Stockfish expected score. Positive differences denote smaller enhanced error. Relative reduction is 100*(baseline−enhanced)/baseline on pooled MAE. Use 10,000 paired resamples of whole odd games (one natural row each), NumPy PCG64/default_rng(202611230851), percentile 2.5th and 97.5th. Report any-absent, none-retained, and all-geometric-rights-present subsets separately, with their within-subset paired resamples using the same seed. The predeclared first test is on the full natural odd arm. Qualification requires point MAE reduction ≥2%, strictly positive lower paired-MAE endpoint and positive MSE reduction. Conditional prediction on these raw games does not establish playing strength or effect of adding features to a trained NNUE.

Local commands, with results confined to scratch:
```sh
cd /workspace/work/phase4-naturalcast
python freeze.py
python controls.py
python work.py
python sentinel.py
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python analyze.py
```

Inputs, incidence, scores and model outputs are preserved in manifest.jsonl, population.csv, gate.json, controls.json, measure.sqlite, sentinel.json, positions.csv and result.json. The manifest's 3,976 included histories SHA-256 is 4fd276058866ba190d9411acc7070dad80fbd532a280a2b5f5d5e6e0704d0f93. The frozen model/analysis script SHA-256 is 0166439c45ce2f5eaa7ca631ab086664b6236111099ae5baa5628828cdf387a8.
~~~
